checks.name: Bounded JSON rejects cycles, deep nesting, nonfinite numbers and prototype-control keys
Manifest rejects unknown hooks, credentials, fragments and extra fields
Request IDs are unique and normal completion does not close a healthy session
Concurrent admission remains bounded after asynchronous authority checks
Caller rate limit rejects excess requests while preserving existing session
Fail closed on unexpected response ID
Fail closed on extra response fields
Fail closed on mixed result and error
Fail closed on invalid error schema
Fail closed on unbounded log text
Guest error data is reduced to a fixed main-owned code
Unsupported host request gets fixed unsupported result and cannot invoke main code
Logs retain a bounded ring and contain fixed codes only
Pre-aborted request returns stable cancellation and closes the guest session
